about.headline: Make room for a clear conversation.
about.lead: A legal question can come with a lot of paperwork. A first visit gives you time to explain what happened and ask what comes next.

Tell the office the general topic when arranging your appointment. Bring the relevant records, dates and questions so the consultation can focus on your situation.

faq.headline: A few questions before you come in.

items.q: How do I arrange a consultation?
items.a: Contact the office with a brief description of the topic and your preferred times. The appointment details and fee are confirmed before your visit.
Bring relevant documents, correspondence and a list of important dates. Keep original records with you unless another arrangement is specifically agreed.

items.q: Can I ask about fees first?
items.a: Yes. Ask about the consultation fee and the scope and cost of any further work before proceeding.

items.q: Does requesting an appointment start legal work?
items.a: An appointment request is an enquiry. The scope and terms of any work are discussed separately with the office.
